resource: Use inputs applied for one actor in one Channel owner work cycle
unit: use inputs per actor per work cycle
allocation_impact: At most one use input is applied per actor per Channel owner work cycle; further inputs remain outstanding FND-02 commands bounded by FND02-OUTSTANDING-COMMANDS, processed FIFO per session and round-robin across actors.
boundary_tests: max=1: one use input for an actor is applied in a work cycle
max+1=2: a second use input for the same actor is not applied in the same work cycle; it stays outstanding and the 65th outstanding command is refused under the existing FND-02 rule
notes: Accepted by the resource owner in #162 comment 5864914163 (USE-WIRE-V1). The server selects the unique bound transition; the client sends intent only. Occupancy, reach and stale-state disposition semantics are decided by USE-WIRE-V1; composition into the Server Seam is M2.
